I’m BigV, and each week I share step-by-step guides, gear reviews, and actionable tips—from building a long-term food pantry to surviving power grid failures and economic downturns. Whether you’re new to prepping or a seasoned survivalist, you’ll find clear, practical advice on:
Stockpiling food & water for SHTF scenarios
Bugging in vs. bugging out strategies
Financial preparedness in uncertain times
Hands-on gear tests & reviews
Subscribe and hit the bell so you never miss a video—let’s make sure you and your family are ready for whatever comes next.

snippet.title: Future Proof Survival
snippet.description:
Future Proof Survival is your no-BS guide to mastering self-reliance, prepping, and survival tactics that actually work when things go sideways. We don’t chase trends or peddle paranoia—we deliver real-world skills, gear reviews, and hard lessons to help you stay alive, prepared, and ten steps ahead.

Whether you're going off-grid, building a bug-out plan, or just sick of being dependent on fragile systems, this channel exists to make sure you’re ready for whatever comes next.

Topics We Cover:

Urban & wilderness survival

Tactical prep & gear breakdowns

Off-grid tools & DIY solutions

Crisis response & mindset training

No hype. No fluff. Just brutally honest, field-tested knowledge.

Subscribe if you're serious about staying ready.

Valuetainment is the leading source for information, education and entertainment centered on the fundamentals of entrepreneurship and capitalism. •

There is a need for a voice that carries the torch for entrepreneurship and capitalism, projecting a compelling, positive message. We are that voice. •

Established and aspirational entrepreneurs, startup founders, students, intrapreneurs, and leaders within all types of organizations (public/private/non-profit). •

snippet.title: City Prepping
snippet.description:
This channel's goal is to help everyday people learn the basics of survival in times of crisis.  With over 80% of Americans living in an Urban/Suburban environment, many lack the basics to ensure they have the necessary food, water, medical skills, and security in the event of a catastrophe. City Prepping's chief aim is to help provide survival basics for everyday people that are practical and easy to implement to be prepared should calamity strike.

snippet.title: Shawn Ryan Show
snippet.description:
Welcome to The Shawn Ryan Show

I'm Shawn Ryan, a former Navy SEAL, a former CIA Contractor, Special Operations Outreach for Veterans Advocacy Services, CNBC Contributor and owner of Vigilance Elite.

If there is one thing you can come to expect on this channel, it is pure honesty.  My main goal here at Vigilance Elite Productions is to give you a little knowledge, with a cool twist of entertainment.  Here you will find everything from War Stories to Self Help videos, funny product reviews  dealing with social anxiety, instructional videos to crowdfunding for those in need.  I've showcased new businesses, personalities, combat veterans, and their products, giving them a tremendous amount of exposure in hopes of helping on the road to success.  I'll talk about my failures and struggles to my proudest moments and my successes.

Welcome to the channel and enjoy.

Follow me on Social Media 
@shawnryanshow

Cheers,

Shawn Ryan
